FFDCC.CoreTooOld: FastFighting DCC needs a newer FastFighting Core. Update FastFighting.
FFDCC.CoreUntested: FastFighting DCC hasn't been tried with FastFighting Core API {major}; some things may not work.

FFDCC.SurrenderedHint: Gave up the fight (FastFighting). Delete this effect once the matter is settled.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: After a successful Intelligence check sizing up a foe, how much likelier a Lore-Collector's rolls against foes of that kind are to succeed, through its next turn.

tiedStopsSpells.Name: Tied up stops spells
tiedStopsSpells.Hint: On: a creature tied up can't cast. Off: it can, and may cast instead of struggling free. The rules don't say which spells need free hands.

Bleed.Last: is bleeding out: the last chance to save them

Body.Dead: is truly dead (Luck check: d20 {roll}, Luck {luck})
Body.Alive: was only unconscious (Luck check: d20 {roll}, Luck {luck}): 1 hit point, groggy
Body.TooCute: was too cute to die (Luck check: d20 {roll}, Luck {luck}; -1 Luck): 1 hit point, groggy

Out.Saved: Saved from bleeding out: -1 Stamina for good, and a scar
Out.Body: Rolled the body: alive at 1 HP, groggy, -1 {ability} for good
